newsitem.title: BELGIUM: INSIGHT - CHARTISTS AGREE BEL-20 HEADING HIGHER.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - CHARTISTS AGREE BEL-20 HEADING HIGHER.

text.p: Leading Belgian shares, despite
signs of being overbought, remain firmly on an upward trend for
now, Belgian technical analysts said on Monday.
However, the Bel-20 Index is likely to encounter
serious resistance at the 1,900 level before breaking sharply
higher again before the year end.
On Monday at midday, the index was up 3.55 points at
1,890.79. On Friday the Bel-20 closed at 1,887.24 against
1,865.21 a week earlier.

Contributors' own analysis (alphabetical order).
ECOFIS - Two more windows in the daily charts last week are
again bullish. The uptrend is intact. The MACD and RSI show
convergence with the Bel-20 over the last three to four months,
a trend-supportive characteristic. A pause is always possible
given the weekly and daily overbought stochastics. But a decline
to below 1791, the cyclical low made at the end of October, is
required to make an inconsistency in the uptrend (Frank Boll).
GENERALE BANK - The trend remains firmly positive, though
the momentum is slowing. Successive strong performances lead the
market to levels not visited before. The saying "the trend is
your friend" remains true. We believe further advances remain on
on the cards. A drop below the 1,835 level should inspire some
stop-loss sales in order to protect accumulated gains. However,
1785 is still the major level to be broken before indicating a
medium-term trend reversal (Geert Vanderbeke).
PARIBAS - All the arguments for a higher Bel-20 index remain
valid: a surging bond market and USD appreciating against most
European currencies. Short-term technicals are still showing
upward momentum and we expect the 1925 zone to be tested before
year-end. The 1900 level remains however a very important
resistance to break. A major correction is only to be expected
if the 1870 level breaks on the downside (Philip Tortelboom).
